scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n packages,web,api,worker "npm run dev:packages" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev -w @social-scheduler/shared" "npm run dev -w @social-scheduler/config" "npm run dev -w @social-scheduler/database" "npm run dev -w @social-scheduler/publishing"
scripts.build:packages: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @social-scheduler/shared -w @social-scheduler/config -w @social-scheduler/database -w @social-scheduler/publishing
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @social-scheduler/api -w @social-scheduler/worker -w @social-scheduler/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
